Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.58, 0.04, 0.38, 0.27899999999999997 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.115, 0.1196, 0.33, 0.14616 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "PUBLICLY AVAILABLE", "label_box": [ 0.10700000000000001, 0.27176, 0.34600000000000003, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.115, 0.3719, 0.33, 0.14616 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "READ IN CONTEXT", "label_box": [ 0.10700000000000001, 0.52406, 0.34600000000000003, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "card", "box": [ 0.115, 0.6242, 0.33, 0.14616 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "LEARNED IN WEIGHTS", "label_box": [ 0.10700000000000001, 0.7763599999999999, 0.34600000000000003, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "stack", "source": "
**Frame:** [Page 039](039.md) panel 6 returns, small and unchanged: Curt's second line drawn through the wipe. Beside it, the `TRAINING-TIME TRANSFER` box from panel 1, with three words stacked inside it and separated by hard rules: `PUBLICLY AVAILABLE` / `READ IN CONTEXT` / `LEARNED IN WEIGHTS`.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> The wiki was up while the model was training. That reopens the question. It does not answer it. Those are three different events and I have evidence for one of them.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — `OAI-BH` 14:06 places training while the Artifactory board was live; the wiki's availability in the same weeks is `CW-EXPORT`. No record establishes that any run read the wiki or that any training update came from it. The channel question from [page 039](039.md) is recalled, not decided.

", "title": "Availability context and learned weights remain different claims" } }
